marta: Quick thread to hash the benchmark narrative for the launch. Thinking a perf-economics framing ("efficiency frontier") instead of plain 'latency vs cost'. Need: hero scatter showing frontier, a marginal-cost waterfall, and a tiny routing matrix for inbound. Draft deck Thu EOD; webinar two weeks out.

sam: Love 'efficiency frontier' 1. It gives us a product/market hook: pick a point on the frontier that matches your SLA and unit economics.

liv: Visuals: 1) hero scatter (median latency log scale X, cost/1k Y) with an overlayed convex hull to show frontier; 2) waterfall that breaks down per-token cost (model, infra, batching savings); 3) routing matrix (fast/expensive vs slow/cheap) that maps to hosted/dedicated/private. Keep colors muted and accessible.

dena: For copy on the hero slide: "Find your efficiency frontier: tradeoffs that actually move the needle for products." CTA: "Run a free micro-bench" with toggles for workload type.

theo: On data 1 I'll run targeted runs: chat short (128 toks), chat prod (256), long-context embeddings (1k). Variants: hosted, dedicated, int8-quant. Posting CSV links when done.

marta: Also include a one-slide customer vignette: "Reduced response latency by 3x and cut per-request cost by 40% by moving to dedicated + routing + prefix cache." Need a 1-2 sentence anonymized quote.

bench-bot: Bench completed: dataset microchat-2026-04. Summary (median ms / cost per 1k / tokens/s per GPU): hosted 130ms / $0.14 / 7k, dedicated 50ms / $0.075 / 30k, int8-quant 70ms / $0.045 / 24k. CSV: /bench/microchat-2026-04/summary.csv

liv: Nice. I'll mock the convex hull hero and the waterfall. Quick ask: can someone give me the p95 deltas for the fat-tail inset?

theo: p95 numbers: hosted 420ms, dedicated 120ms, int8-quant 180ms. I'll add a small percent-difference column in the CSV.

sam: Webinar structure idea: 1) why efficiency frontier matters (2-3 slides), 2) demo: running a micro-bench + interpreting the frontier (live), 3) engineering levers (routing, quant, batching), 4) customer vignette, 5) CTA + how to get a tailored bench. Aim 25m + 10m Q&A.

revops-bot: Suggested lead form fields for 'micro-bench' CTA: company name, email, estimated monthly tokens, desired SLA (p50/p95), deployment preference (hosted/dedicated/private), primary contact role. Auto-tag: "bench-request". Post to RevOps queue.

marta: Nice. Noah (cc'ed in doc): can you draft a RevOps rulebook: bench-request -> tag ARR >50k -> AE alert; bench-request + "private" -> Security review.

liv: Mock image notes: overlay copy "Pick where you want to sit on the frontier" and a subtle diagonal gradient. Will export PNGs tomorrow morning.

marta: Small code snippet for the hero hull for whoever wants to reproduce it quick:
```python
# quick hull + scatter (seaborn/matplotlib)
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.spatial import ConvexHull

df = pd.read_csv('bench_summary.csv')
# scatter
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='median_ms', y='cost_per_1k', hue='variant', s=80)
# compute convex hull over numeric points to show frontier
pts = df[['median_ms','cost_per_1k']].values
hull = ConvexHull(pts)
plt.plot(pts[hull.vertices,0], pts[hull.vertices,1], '--', color='gray')
plt.xscale('log')
plt.xlabel('Median latency (ms)')
plt.ylabel('Cost per 1k tokens ($)')
plt.title('Efficiency frontier: performance vs unit economics')
plt.savefig('eff_frontier_hero.png', dpi=150)
```

dena: For messaging test variants, let's A/B headline: A) "Find your efficiency frontier" B) "Where latency meets economics". Test on landing page and webinar signup.

marta: Action items: theo -> final CSV + p95 col (EOD). liv -> first mock PNGs (AM). dena -> two headlines and short landing blurb. sam -> webinar outline + demo script. noah -> RevOps rule draft. I'll pull this into the deck and share for feedback. Thanks all. :sparkles:
